payload.summary: Documents search can show high latency; no document-search stall watchdog (Guidelines draft link is intentional)
payload.detail: Live QA: documents mode searching "guideline" previously appeared to hang on Finding matching documents; re-verification later resolved in ~20s with 20 results (flaky latency, not confirmed indefinite hang). tools-catalog guidelines href is /?mode=documents&q=guideline&focus=1 without run=1 — this matches the intentional focused unsubmitted draft contract in page.tsx / global-search-shell.tsx (same pattern as other prompt-style Tools links). Do NOT add run=1 to that href. /api/search has no document stall watchdog comparable to answer streams. /documents/search page is a stub; dashboard mount depends on run=1 off /. Next: add stall/timeout UX for document search LoadingPanel; assert Tools→Guidelines reaches a focused draft (not auto-run) and surfaces results or a clear error after explicit submit under N seconds. Stop: do not treat RANZCP empty results as a defect unless corpus expects hits; do not bypass the draft-link contract.
payload.source: session 2026-09-13 live QA; Codex review: run=1 is not a defect for draft Tools links
